response.overview: Eye Contact is a film that explores a genre of a short road-movie with a pinch of science fiction and reflection on intimacy, relationships and the technologies. The film puts viewers inside of a world where CCULDESACC presents innovative contact lenses that let people swap POVs, allowing you to literally see what your partner sees. This transformative experience—a mix of derealisation and depersonalisation—offers a peculiar, narcissistic satisfaction.  Two male lovers find themselves on a weekend road trip. They establish a new connection by using their innovative CCULDESACC eye lenses and exchange their POVs. Partners are drawn to each other drowning in the new sensations while having sex right behind the steering wheel.
response.tagline: Would you fuck yourself? We bet you would.
response.title: Eye Contact
